name: Task contract in project guidance
purpose: Keep the goal, constraints and acceptance checks explicit.

name: Targeted source packet
purpose: Include relevant files and anchored excerpts before reading broadly.

name: Load skills when needed
purpose: Keep skill discovery concise and load only the current stage.

name: Bound successful tool results
purpose: Keep full evidence on disk and a short useful excerpt in context.

name: Local evidence ledger
purpose: Record tool completion metadata without repasting logs.

name: Goal reminder at prompt boundary
purpose: Re-anchor the current request and acceptance checks.

name: Prepare compaction checkpoint
purpose: Preserve decisions, evidence and unfinished checks before compaction.

name: Restore checkpoint on resume
purpose: Restore a validated small state packet instead of repasting history.

name: Scoped worker input
purpose: Give a worker only its task, sources and acceptance contract.

name: Validate worker return
purpose: Admit a bounded source-linked report rather than raw worker history.

name: Route scoped work by difficulty
purpose: Use smaller models for bounded evidence work and escalate uncertainty.

name: One workflow with stage contracts
purpose: Connect diagnosis, repair, local checks and revision-linked CI.

name: Stable reusable prefix
purpose: Keep reusable instructions and tool definitions stable.

name: Cache usage audit
purpose: Separate fresh input, cache reads/writes and output costs.

name: Failure triage
purpose: Use when a QA failure needs a bounded reproduction and evidence-based product-versus-test classification.

name: Fixture isolation review
purpose: Use when parallel or order-dependent tests suggest shared mutable fixtures, cleanup collisions or cross-test data leakage.

name: Regression design
purpose: Use when turning a supported defect hypothesis into a deterministic regression and appropriately scoped verification plan.

name: Verification evidence report
purpose: Use when reconciling local and CI checks into an honest, revision-linked QA handoff or release-readiness report.

name: Repair a regression
purpose: Use when a known regression needs a minimal fix, deterministic test and revision-linked local and CI verification.

name: Validate release readiness
purpose: Use when preparing a release-readiness assessment from scoped requirements, regression risks and actual local or CI evidence.
